tasks.title: Implement reviewed repair-to-prune handoff
tasks.summary: Add explicit handoff review between drift/repair evidence and prune approval workflows without granting deletion authority from repair evidence.
notes: Handoff evidence must not authorize physical prune.
Existing prune dry-run, approval, apply, receipt, and supersede controls remain authoritative.
Unresolved or stale drift/repair evidence must block handoff.
